name: Saudi Arabia
summary: Three MNOs (stc, Mobily, Zain KSA), with Salam (ex-Atheeb) as a fixed/FWA licensee. CST has licensed IMT spectrum through five auctions since 2017. The latest (November 2024: 600, 700 and 3800 MHz) raised the total licensed for mobile networks from 1110 MHz to 1400 MHz. Per-operator holdings in the legacy and 2017–2019 bands are not published.

operators.name: stc
operators.notes: Incumbent. Won 2×20 MHz at 600 MHz and 100 MHz at 3800 MHz in the November 2024 auction. Also won both 2100 MHz NTN channels (2×30 MHz) in the December 2022 non-terrestrial-network auction.

operators.name: Mobily
operators.notes: e& owns 28%. Total spectrum is 440 MHz after winning 120 MHz (700 MHz 2×10 + 3800 MHz 100) in the 2024 auction on 15-year licences (e& 2024 integrated report). It won 100 MHz at 3.5 GHz in March 2019 (e& 2019 annual report) and bought 2.6 GHz and '3.7 GHz' spectrum in 2020 (e& 2020 annual report).

operators.name: Zain KSA
operators.notes: Won 2×15 MHz at 600 MHz in the 2024 auction.

operators.name: Salam
operators.notes: Fixed/FWA operator (rebranded from Atheeb/GO). Won 1800 MHz spectrum in the June 2017 auction (CITC). The amount is not verified, so it is not drawn.

bands.label: 600 MHz FDD
bands.note: First 600 MHz award in Europe/Middle East/Africa (5th IMT auction, November 2024). All 2×35 MHz was sold: stc '40 MHz', Zain '30 MHz' (CST counts both directions). Positions are not published. The band plan is assumed to be the US 617–652/663–698 layout (n71), since CST offered 2×35 MHz.

bands.label: 700 MHz – 2024 auction lot
bands.note: Only the 2×10 MHz lot sold in 2024 is shown. Earlier 700 MHz lots (2×30 MHz auctioned in 2017, 2×10 MHz in 2018) are held by stc, Mobily and Zain in amounts not verified; see the next entry.

bands.label: 700 MHz – 2017/2018 auction lots
bands.note: CITC auctioned 700 MHz in June 2017 (2×30 MHz, with 1800 MHz; 140 MHz sold in total to stc, Mobily, Zain and Atheeb) and in February 2018 (2×10 MHz, with 800 and 1800 MHz; 80 MHz sold). Per-operator amounts and positions are not published by CST in the pages reached.

bands.label: 800 MHz FDD
bands.note: Legacy 800 MHz assignments, plus 2×40 MHz offered in the 2018 auction (CST table). In March 2020 CITC temporarily added 40 MHz in the 700/800 MHz bands. Mobily and others use B20. Per-operator amounts and positions are not published by CST in the pages reached.

bands.label: 850 MHz
bands.note: No IMT assignment identified. Saudi Arabia uses 800 MHz B20 and 900 MHz B8.

bands.label: 900 MHz
bands.note: GSM/UMTS licences of stc, Mobily and Zain. Per-operator amounts and positions are not published by CST in the pages reached.

bands.label: 1.5 GHz L-band
bands.note: Not assigned. CST's IMT page lists 1500 MHz as 'to be offered'.

bands.label: AWS 1.7/2.1 GHz
bands.note: Not harmonised in ITU Region 1. 1710–1785 MHz is used as the B3 uplink.

bands.label: 1800 MHz
bands.note: Legacy GSM 1800 assignments, plus 2×46 MHz offered in 2017 and 2×30 MHz offered in 2018 (CST table; not all sold). Holders are stc, Mobily, Zain and Atheeb/Salam. Per-operator amounts and positions are not published by CST in the pages reached.

bands.label: PCS 1900
bands.note: PCS is not used in Region 1. For the 2 GHz MSS/NTN band, see 'other'.

bands.label: 1900–1920 MHz TDD
bands.note: Status not verified.

bands.label: 2100 MHz
bands.note: 3G licences of stc, Mobily and Zain. Per-operator amounts and positions are not published by CST in the pages reached.

bands.label: 2300 MHz TDD
bands.note: 100 MHz offered in CST's third auction. stc uses B40 (40 MHz carriers per Wikipedia). Per-operator amounts and positions are not published by CST in the pages reached.

bands.label: 2500–2690 MHz
bands.note: 190 MHz offered in CST's third auction. Mobily uses B7/B41, stc B41 and Zain B7. Mobily bought 2.6 GHz spectrum in 2020 (e& 2020 annual report). Per-operator amounts and positions are not published by CST in the pages reached.

bands.label: 3800–4000 MHz (2024 auction)
bands.note: 5th IMT auction (November 2024): all 200 MHz sold, 100 MHz each to stc and Mobily. Positions are not published.

bands.label: 3400–3800 MHz (2019 auction)
bands.note: CST's 4th auction offered 400 MHz at 3500 MHz. Only Mobily's 100 MHz (March 2019, e& 2019 annual report) is confirmed. stc and Zain also run n78 5G, but their amounts are not verified. Mobily's 2020 '3.7 GHz' purchase (e& 2020 annual report) may be part of this entry or additional.

bands.label: 4.4–5.0 GHz
bands.note: No IMT assignment identified; the band is not in CST's list of auctioned bands.

bands.label: 6 GHz
bands.note: No IMT licence. CITC's 2021 outlook made 6.2 GHz of spectrum licence-exempt, including 6 GHz Wi-Fi, and CST has consulted on light licensing for 6 GHz. CST, stc and Nokia trialled 7 GHz for 6G (October 2025).

bands.label: 26 GHz
bands.note: CITC's 2021 outlook planned more than 13 GHz of lightly licensed spectrum, which is understood to include mmWave. Whether 26 GHz has been licensed to operators could not be verified.

bands.label: 37–43.5 GHz
bands.note: No assignment identified.

bands.label: 47 GHz
bands.note: No assignment identified.

bands.label: 2 GHz NTN / MSS (1980–2010 / 2170–2200 MHz)
bands.note: World-first auction for non-terrestrial networks (A2G and MSS), held from 30 November 2022. stc won both channels, 60 MHz in total. The band edges are assumed to be the 2 GHz MSS band, since CST gave '2100 MHz, 30×2 MHz'.

notes: CST reports amounts per auction but, in the pages reached, no per-operator register of frequencies. Only the 2024 auction (600/700/3800), the 2022 NTN auction and Mobily's 2019 3.5 GHz lot are attributed to operators here.
CST: total licensed IMT spectrum rose from 1110 MHz to 1400 MHz with the 2024 auction. The per-operator totals shown are far below this because legacy holdings are missing.
Mobily's total after the 2024 auction is 440 MHz (e& 2024 integrated report). Only 220 MHz of it is attributed here by band.
missing: Per-operator amounts and positions for 700 (2017/18 lots), 800, 900, 1800, 2100, 2300, 2600 and 3400–3800 MHz (stc and Zain) are unknown. These bands are shown as 'unknown' or partial.
Salam/Atheeb 1800 MHz amount (won in 2017) is unknown.
Whether 26 GHz or other mmWave spectrum has been licensed to operators is unknown.
Mobily's 2020 2.6 GHz and '3.7 GHz' acquisitions: amounts unknown.
Block positions for all bands. EARFCN/NR-ARFCN not compiled.
